name: Langtang Valley Trek
summary: A there-and-back walk up the Langtang valley from Syabrubesi through Lama Hotel and the rebuilt Langtang village to Kyanjin Gompa at 3,870 m, with an acclimatisation day for the Kyanjin Ri viewpoint at 4,773 m. Some itineraries add the longer climb to Tserko Ri at 4,984 m instead.

name: Langtang–Gosaikunda Trek
summary: Joins the Langtang valley to the Gosaikunda lakes by crossing Laurebina La at 4,610 m, and most itineraries then continue down through Helambu to Sundarijal. The pass day is the long one and can hold snow outside the two main seasons.

name: Gosaikunda Trek
summary: A short climb from Dhunche past Sing Gompa to the lake basin at 4,380 m, usually returning the same way. The lakes are a Hindu pilgrimage site and draw large crowds at Janai Purnima in August; itineraries that carry on over Laurebina La into Helambu reach 4,610 m.

name: Helambu Trek
summary: A village-to-village loop that starts at Sundarijal on the rim of the Kathmandu valley and runs through Chisapani and Kutumsang to Tharepati, then down into the Yolmo villages of Tarke Ghyang and Sermathang. It stays lower than the other Langtang routes and needs no long drive to reach the trailhead.

name: Tamang Heritage Trail
summary: A loop out of Syabrubesi through the Tamang villages of Gatlang, Tatopani, Thuman and Briddim, with the Nagthali ridge at 3,165 m as its high point. It is a low-altitude cultural route on lodge trails, often walked as an add-on before or after the Langtang valley.
